faqs.q: How long does a Sri Lanka ETA take?
faqs.a: Usually 1 to 3 working days, but apply at least a week before you travel to be safe.

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a Sri Lanka visa?
faqs.a: Yes, most visitors need an ETA or eVisa before travelling. We confirm the current fee for your nationality.

faqs.q: Can I extend my Sri Lanka visa?
faqs.a: Tourist stays can usually be extended once you are in Sri Lanka, through the immigration department.

sections.heading: Sri Lanka ETA for tourists
sections.text: Most visitors, including British citizens, need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) or eVisa before travelling to Sri Lanka. Tourist visits are usually granted for up to 30 days, and stays can be extended once you're in the country. Fees vary by nationality, and Sri Lanka has offered free tourist visas to some nationalities at times, so we confirm the current fee before you apply.

sections.heading: Business and transit
sections.text: Business visitors need a business ETA, usually with a letter from the Sri Lankan company you're visiting. Travellers passing through Sri Lanka for up to 2 days may need a transit ETA.

sections.heading: Apply before you fly
sections.text: Apply online before you travel and carry a copy of the approval. Make sure the passport number on your ETA matches the passport you travel with: if you renew your passport, you need a new ETA. Our online form reads your passport and fills in your details for you.

sections.heading: Sri Lanka visa: tips before you travel
sections.text: Check that your passport is valid for at least 6 months from your arrival date. Apply for your Sri Lanka visa or ETA with the same passport you will travel on, and carry a printed or saved copy of the approval. If you're staying longer than your ETA allows, plan your extension before it runs out.

sections.heading: Sri Lanka visa help in Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the North West and the rest of the UK. Most travel visa applications can be handled by post and email, so you don't need to visit us in person.
